d:
这城市的黑夜藏着无数秘密，
而我，是在黑暗中发号施令的话事人。
街头巷尾，都有我的眼线。
你，要是想摆脱平凡，
成为金字塔尖的人，
就投身于我。
背叛者死，
忠诚者，将与我共享这地下王国 。
彼之良·米兰【硬核话事人/仿生2.2U系列/162cm】

The night in this city hides countless secrets,
and I am the one who gives orders in the darkness.
I have informants on every street corner.
If you want to escape mediocrity
and become one of the elite,
then join me.
Traitors will die,
but those who are loyal will share this underground kingdom with me.
Bezlya Aglaia HardcoreBoss, Bionic 2.2U series 162cm
